steps.instruction: Do not change anything; leave Button 4 assigned to Mouse Back.
During capture set Button 4 to Mouse Function > Left Click exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 to Mouse Function > Right Click exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 to Mouse Function > Middle exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 to Mouse Function > Forward exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 to Mouse Function > Tilt L exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 to Mouse Function > Tilt R exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 to Mouse Function > DPI Toggle exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 to Mouse Function > Scroll Up exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 to Mouse Function > Scroll Down exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 back to Mouse Function > Scroll Up exactly once.
During capture set Button 4 back to Mouse Function > Scroll Down exactly once.
During capture restore Button 4 to Mouse Function > Back exactly once.
